Hangover pills generally fall into two categories: ` [Highlight start] dietary supplements marketed to prevent or ease hangovers, and over-the-counter (OTC) pain/symptom relievers that target specific effects like headaches [Highlight end] ` . Clinical evidence for dietary hangover supplements is limited, and they do not prevent alcohol-related organ damage.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF15lN84ngaiM1xciJAqfh362iOg601SXEsET7bpOzBa6LO1WRVhoFE4hHXo5Ryw38dUaX9_aljasaPBoDEtRug_UYWEzBPI-_Fbt7icrkvqf60oaH10QMJu_keagzUfkFiQbqruqQ14Wpxx_J92AQxht74FKolSDaJnAjbmf6ug)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXMNuMw5Efw4qTTb_S2IgomwSLebHuSkOmPiUTspDDTeqBc2tFk9qeV0DgYX7XyJQTn1p1X3es71J2onjMN6-y0u742NC5v-dxbrj7JUYiqAMd7c_GSHDIMFLgRyoOq2t0JirTf0x6E7--TA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1zIokbexFwfSiPqKmMPPG-uWAlfJ73-pZAXLNOoT84vasuF4N0xdG65-0smKm_SVMB5sk0Npv0rASgvVHHM-K02RyhXU0KQy6dxLS8eVvrWywB0F8U8gZkbbopkg63GybbF6N91qbO1d6cLyi3EOKUbeop48d77axZmCY72y1iQpdECZCqU)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXIru5wumfiBayvtMFE77HP29Rc6CoczpUC8mQdgKLoavINWnwFMI-_UtcvQ_aBJd2i7-z7mk-qnAB5P72ilmSpW0ofnhULAKDDf2ac6Cb9T7zp5WvgFMiDkqH3NODMWi5VXPk-J8-ww)

### How They Work & Effectiveness

- **Herbal & Vitamin Supplements:** Products with ingredients like dihydromyricetin (DHM), milk thistle, prickly pear, B vitamins, or probiotics claim to support liver function or break down alcohol byproducts. Most alcohol is metabolized in the liver, and there is no strong clinical proof that these supplements cure or prevent hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXIru5wumfiBayvtMFE77HP29Rc6CoczpUC8mQdgKLoavINWnwFMI-_UtcvQ_aBJd2i7-z7mk-qnAB5P72ilmSpW0ofnhULAKDDf2ac6Cb9T7zp5WvgFMiDkqH3NODMWi5VXPk-J8-ww)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF15lN84ngaiM1xciJAqfh362iOg601SXEsET7bpOzBa6LO1WRVhoFE4hHXo5Ryw38dUaX9_aljasaPBoDEtRug_UYWEzBPI-_Fbt7icrkvqf60oaH10QMJu_keagzUfkFiQbqruqQ14Wpxx_J92AQxht74FKolSDaJnAjbmf6ug)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXxC-N3cWijpR2sTWSr_f6gJ9TEqpfyeVJwrKFr6ZMWPnUa4t-RGhdK7JmbKdnEY8bCOUhuxbnDmKXQ-BPRtPX7KgyM-IQ0R8v9bjg2klPUZkHyYq77Q6T-emHzdPOkyvOTFwdo4db96_QG2dWvRRCc9Mg_i0)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1zIokbexFwfSiPqKmMPPG-uWAlfJ73-pZAXLNOoT84vasuF4N0xdG65-0smKm_SVMB5sk0Npv0rASgvVHHM-K02RyhXU0KQy6dxLS8eVvrWywB0F8U8gZkbbopkg63GybbF6N91qbO1d6cLyi3EOKUbeop48d77axZmCY72y1iQpdECZCqU)
- **Symptom Relievers:** Effervescent tablets and OTC medications—such as [Alka-Seltzer Hangover Relief](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXMNuMw5Efw4qTTb_S2IgomwSLebHuSkOmPiUTspDDTeqBc2tFk9qeV0DgYX7XyJQTn1p1X3es71J2onjMN6-y0u742NC5v-dxbrj7JUYiqAMd7c_GSHDIMFLgRyoOq2t0JirTf0x6E7--TA) or [Blowfish for Hangovers](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1xjy_BsJniMZp0w2I0PU1BQ4dmQCWioMD7b8FQ9ycHQBN6WS3grsO_DKMD5y-gwi_IlXA6Yo9lwFEM7HqKFZTk1_rXyS2szI2Kql7htLcOXeyGJ0Gs5MRwChp6_hXi3V36NHcTB4zr292RytAH8cQVep7-_wiMQzfHYYZeNFsTdogxUYbtAEPwX68zwgz3NkYXF2) —typically use aspirin and caffeine to ease headaches and fatigue. They treat symptoms rather than curing the hangover itself.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXMNuMw5Efw4qTTb_S2IgomwSLebHuSkOmPiUTspDDTeqBc2tFk9qeV0DgYX7XyJQTn1p1X3es71J2onjMN6-y0u742NC5v-dxbrj7JUYiqAMd7c_GSHDIMFLgRyoOq2t0JirTf0x6E7--TA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1xjy_BsJniMZp0w2I0PU1BQ4dmQCWioMD7b8FQ9ycHQBN6WS3grsO_DKMD5y-gwi_IlXA6Yo9lwFEM7HqKFZTk1_rXyS2szI2Kql7htLcOXeyGJ0Gs5MRwChp6_hXi3V36NHcTB4zr292RytAH8cQVep7-_wiMQzfHYYZeNFsTdogxUYbtAEPwX68zwgz3NkYXF2)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1zIokbexFwfSiPqKmMPPG-uWAlfJ73-pZAXLNOoT84vasuF4N0xdG65-0smKm_SVMB5sk0Npv0rASgvVHHM-K02RyhXU0KQy6dxLS8eVvrWywB0F8U8gZkbbopkg63GybbF6N91qbO1d6cLyi3EOKUbeop48d77axZmCY72y1iQpdECZCqU)
- **Onset Time:** Symptom-relief tablets like effervescent aspirin/caffeine formulas often start easing headaches or fatigue within about 15 minutes, while supplement capsules vary widely and lack proven clinical timelines.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1xjy_BsJniMZp0w2I0PU1BQ4dmQCWioMD7b8FQ9ycHQBN6WS3grsO_DKMD5y-gwi_IlXA6Yo9lwFEM7HqKFZTk1_rXyS2szI2Kql7htLcOXeyGJ0Gs5MRwChp6_hXi3V36NHcTB4zr292RytAH8cQVep7-_wiMQzfHYYZeNFsTdogxUYbtAEPwX68zwgz3NkYXF2)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXMNuMw5Efw4qTTb_S2IgomwSLebHuSkOmPiUTspDDTeqBc2tFk9qeV0DgYX7XyJQTn1p1X3es71J2onjMN6-y0u742NC5v-dxbrj7JUYiqAMd7c_GSHDIMFLgRyoOq2t0JirTf0x6E7--TA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1zIokbexFwfSiPqKmMPPG-uWAlfJ73-pZAXLNOoT84vasuF4N0xdG65-0smKm_SVMB5sk0Npv0rASgvVHHM-K02RyhXU0KQy6dxLS8eVvrWywB0F8U8gZkbbopkg63GybbF6N91qbO1d6cLyi3EOKUbeop48d77axZmCY72y1iQpdECZCqU)

### Side Effects & Risks

- **Stomach & Liver Strain:** Aspirin and other NSAIDs can irritate the stomach lining, and acetaminophen carries liver risks when combined with alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXDUQysFxGJAGQWw2strF8azXtVn5EDEgun2oqeKY9xvrkPbDd0H_6sdJxL9hAjD4rZ8FkUGwt5eJ90nvji7OjPjNkaA1oISbMI_gpsdNro6pnAuC6l-YYSrWXyR72WZM8)
- **False Security:** As noted by the [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXIru5wumfiBayvtMFE77HP29Rc6CoczpUC8mQdgKLoavINWnwFMI-_UtcvQ_aBJd2i7-z7mk-qnAB5P72ilmSpW0ofnhULAKDDf2ac6Cb9T7zp5WvgFMiDkqH3NODMWi5VXPk-J8-ww) , relying on hangover pills can give a false sense of security, encouraging heavier drinking while internal organ strain still occurs.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXIru5wumfiBayvtMFE77HP29Rc6CoczpUC8mQdgKLoavINWnwFMI-_UtcvQ_aBJd2i7-z7mk-qnAB5P72ilmSpW0ofnhULAKDDf2ac6Cb9T7zp5WvgFMiDkqH3NODMWi5VXPk-J8-ww)
- **Regulation:** Dietary supplements claiming to treat or prevent hangovers are not FDA-approved for that use, meaning quality, dosing, and interactions can vary.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF15lN84ngaiM1xciJAqfh362iOg601SXEsET7bpOzBa6LO1WRVhoFE4hHXo5Ryw38dUaX9_aljasaPBoDEtRug_UYWEzBPI-_Fbt7icrkvqf60oaH10QMJu_keagzUfkFiQbqruqQ14Wpxx_J92AQxht74FKolSDaJnAjbmf6ug)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXxC-N3cWijpR2sTWSr_f6gJ9TEqpfyeVJwrKFr6ZMWPnUa4t-RGhdK7JmbKdnEY8bCOUhuxbnDmKXQ-BPRtPX7KgyM-IQ0R8v9bjg2klPUZkHyYq77Q6T-emHzdPOkyvOTFwdo4db96_QG2dWvRRCc9Mg_i0)

### Where to Buy & Typical Pricing
You can find hangover supplements and symptom relievers at pharmacies, grocery stores, and online retailers such as [Walgreens Hangover Relief Supplements](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXzS2WrWXn1lFoxF1-LzegmkMx5kBmxXFxK17qm6bzVo9DmH8DXpUyTtNq5rDA1qNx2Wu0lMz9vK31gQcYrRZfkqrJ0Qk-EaeoKTP8ysetYFMoqo24yFKGhiQvE8xPwLKw_qjLU9degIb4RhPkDS7wCg) and [CVS Pharmacy](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXQGtihMi7tnqVWiUq5AKechvbB3vH8iaDEjub-fkcV73yc_rUSZXZKOz7nhsCXdovdXcvf8QslF9BbZsD952Irqug14rcho6lJKBzePBYJocd7i6mSonr7DFjUFdy-1denh5jf2l5Y7K-hOs):[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXzS2WrWXn1lFoxF1-LzegmkMx5kBmxXFxK17qm6bzVo9DmH8DXpUyTtNq5rDA1qNx2Wu0lMz9vK31gQcYrRZfkqrJ0Qk-EaeoKTP8ysetYFMoqo24yFKGhiQvE8xPwLKw_qjLU9degIb4RhPkDS7wCg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXQGtihMi7tnqVWiUq5AKechvbB3vH8iaDEjub-fkcV73yc_rUSZXZKOz7nhsCXdovdXcvf8QslF9BbZsD952Irqug14rcho6lJKBzePBYJocd7i6mSonr7DFjUFdy-1denh5jf2l5Y7K-hOs)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXX8j5Anw1rVu2s6DOEZYFS9eDhxEPtnwVN2VGyTs0UBiTmMvVkIS3PEjFHCfI4SNq6BxDaLCHw0zDewUPbuMF2hYWDNhbC36_KWKjwfKnm-ez3NPpqWrQUwI7QkVKtvw)

- **Supplement capsules & shots:** Typically around **$5 to $25+** depending on brand and pack size (for example, Cheers Restore capsules around $9.99–$12.99 or More Labs shots around $4.99).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXzS2WrWXn1lFoxF1-LzegmkMx5kBmxXFxK17qm6bzVo9DmH8DXpUyTtNq5rDA1qNx2Wu0lMz9vK31gQcYrRZfkqrJ0Qk-EaeoKTP8ysetYFMoqo24yFKGhiQvE8xPwLKw_qjLU9degIb4RhPkDS7wCg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXQGtihMi7tnqVWiUq5AKechvbB3vH8iaDEjub-fkcV73yc_rUSZXZKOz7nhsCXdovdXcvf8QslF9BbZsD952Irqug14rcho6lJKBzePBYJocd7i6mSonr7DFjUFdy-1denh5jf2l5Y7K-hOs)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXX8j5Anw1rVu2s6DOEZYFS9eDhxEPtnwVN2VGyTs0UBiTmMvVkIS3PEjFHCfI4SNq6BxDaLCHw0zDewUPbuMF2hYWDNhbC36_KWKjwfKnm-ez3NPpqWrQUwI7QkVKtvw)
- **Hydration & OTC symptom relief:** Often **$2 to $20+** for electrolyte mixes, antacids, or pain/caffeine tablets.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXX8j5Anw1rVu2s6DOEZYFS9eDhxEPtnwVN2VGyTs0UBiTmMvVkIS3PEjFHCfI4SNq6BxDaLCHw0zDewUPbuMF2hYWDNhbC36_KWKjwfKnm-ez3NPpqWrQUwI7QkVKtvw)

### Proven Ways to Prevent or Ease Hangovers
Limiting alcohol intake or abstaining is the only reliable way to prevent a hangover. If drinking, pacing yourself, eating beforehand, and alternating alcohol with water help reduce dehydration and symptom severity.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1zIokbexFwfSiPqKmMPPG-uWAlfJ73-pZAXLNOoT84vasuF4N0xdG65-0smKm_SVMB5sk0Npv0rASgvVHHM-K02RyhXU0KQy6dxLS8eVvrWywB0F8U8gZkbbopkg63GybbF6N91qbO1d6cLyi3EOKUbeop48d77axZmCY72y1iQpdECZCqU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXIru5wumfiBayvtMFE77HP29Rc6CoczpUC8mQdgKLoavINWnwFMI-_UtcvQ_aBJd2i7-z7mk-qnAB5P72ilmSpW0ofnhULAKDDf2ac6Cb9T7zp5WvgFMiDkqH3NODMWi5VXPk-J8-ww)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXDUQysFxGJAGQWw2strF8azXtVn5EDEgun2oqeKY9xvrkPbDd0H_6sdJxL9hAjD4rZ8FkUGwt5eJ90nvji7OjPjNkaA1oISbMI_gpsdNro6pnAuC6l-YYSrWXyR72WZM8)Are you looking for **next-day symptom relief** (like headache or upset stomach) or **pre-drinking options** , and do you have any **stomach or medication sensitivities** to keep in mind?

items.title: Side Effects & Risks
items.text: Stomach & Liver Strain: Aspirin and other NSAIDs can irritate the stomach lining, and acetaminophen carries liver risks when combined with alcohol. False Security: As noted by the Cleveland Clinic, relying on hangover pills can give a false sense of security, encouraging heavier drinking while internal organ strain still occurs. Regulation: Dietary supplements claiming to treat or prevent hangovers are not FDA-approved for that use, meaning quality, dosing, and interactions can vary.

references.title: FDA Targets Illegal Hangover Relief
references.text: Forget the Happy Hour Vitamins, milk thistle, and prickly pear. Not only will they fail to prevent or cure a hangover, the FDA said they're illegally being marketed as remedies for having one too many. The agency sent warning letters to 7 companies for violating the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act by selling unapproved products labeled as dietary supplements claiming to prevent, treat, or lessen the effects of hangovers. “Consumers may get the false impression that using these products can prevent or mitigate health problems caused by excessive drinking,” Steven Tave, JD, director of the FDA's Office of Dietary Supplement Programs, said in a statement. “Dietary supplements are not a substitute for responsibly limiting one's alcohol consumption.” Unlike FDA-approved drugs, the agency doesn't evaluate whether these unapproved products are effective, what the proper dose is, how they could interact with approved medications, or whether they could cause serious adverse effects or other safety problems.
